title: Data Engineer + Instructor
description:
**About Newton School of Technology:**
NST is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a four-year B.Tech programme in Computer Science and AI, emphasising hands-on learning, industry integration, and real-world problem-solving.

With industry-focused projects, practical learning opportunities, and exposure to emerging technologies, NST aims to prepare students for advanced technology careers. Its faculty brings together academic expertise and industry experience to create an engaging, outcome-driven learning environment.

**About the Role:**
We are looking for an experienced
**Data Engineer & Data Visualisation Instructor**
to join our academic team in Sonipat. This role combines technical expertise with teaching, mentoring, and curriculum development. The ideal candidate will have strong practical knowledge of databases, SQL, data engineering, and data visualisation, along with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into engaging, hands-on learning experiences.

You will design and deliver industry-relevant courses, mentor students through practical assignments and capstone projects, and help develop the next generation of data professionals.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Curriculum Development**

* Design and develop course content, lesson plans, lab exercises, and assessments covering DBMS, data engineering, and data visualisation.
* Develop practical assignments and projects aligned with industry practices and current technologies.
* Continuously update curriculum content to reflect emerging trends in databases, business intelligence, analytics, and cloud technologies.

**2. Teaching and Training**

* Deliver lectures, workshops, and hands-on sessions on database management systems, SQL, data modelling, and database design.
* Teach relational database concepts, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, transactions, and database security.
* Train students in Python, data processing, ETL/ELT concepts, and introductory data pipeline development.
* Teach data visualisation and reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or equivalent tools.
* Introduce students to data warehousing, cloud databases, and relevant industry use cases.

**3. Practical Projects and Industry Application**

* Design real-world projects involving data collection, transformation, analysis, and visualisation.
* Develop capstone projects that integrate data engineering, business intelligence, and, where relevant, AI/ML applications.
* Incorporate industry scenarios and datasets to help students develop practical problem-solving skills.
* Guide students in building portfolio-ready projects that demonstrate their technical capabilities.

**4. Student Assessment and Mentorship**

* Develop quizzes, assignments, coding exercises, and project-based assessments.
* Evaluate student performance and provide actionable feedback.
* Mentor students in debugging, troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and technical problem-solving.
* Support students in building career-ready skills and preparing for data engineering, database, and analytics roles.

**5. Industry Collaboration**

* Stay updated on industry tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Conduct technical workshops, guest sessions, hackathons, and project demonstrations.
* Collaborate with other faculty members to integrate data concepts into multidisciplinary projects.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of teaching methodologies and learning outcomes.

**Qualifications and Experience :**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field, or Phd in Computer Science
* **Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience**
  in data engineering, database development, BI/data analytics, or related technical roles.
* Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly and mentor others.
* Prior teaching, training, mentoring, or technical enablement experience is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and at least one major relational database, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server.
* Good understanding of database design, data modelling, normalisation, indexing, query optimisation, and performance tuning.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing and automation.
* Practical experience with data visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT workflows, data pipelines, and data warehousing concepts.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB is an advantage.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms and services, such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

**What We Are Looking For**

* A hands-on technology professional who enjoys teaching and mentoring.
* Someone who can bridge the gap between theoretical concepts and real-world industry applications.
* A candidate who can build engaging learning experiences and guide students through practical projects.
* A collaborative individual who is passionate about developing future-ready technology talent.

title: Assistant Professor - Data Engineer
description:
**About Newton:**

Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley. Led by a distinguished faculty comprising ICPC World Finalists and ex-professionals from ISRO, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip, and several other leading tech organizations, NST is building a scalable, high-impact model that produces industry-ready talent for the world’s most advanced technology roles.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced
**Assistant Professor**
-
**Data Engineer**
to join our team. This role is a perfect blend of technical leadership and mentoring. You’ll be contributing to cutting-edge web development projects while guiding and inspiring the next generation of software engineers.

If you’re passionate about coding, solving complex problems, and helping others grow, this role is for you!

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Curriculum Development:

● Design and develop Data Visual Analytics, DBMS course content, lesson plans,

and practical assignments.

● Stay updated with the latest trends in database technologies and incorporate them

into the curriculum.

**2. Teaching and Training:**

● Deliver lectures and hands-on sessions on database concepts such as relational

models, SQL, NoSQL, normalization, and database design.

● Provide real-world use cases and examples to enhance student understanding.

● Teach advanced topics like query optimization, database security, data warehousing,

and cloud databases.

● Build real-world capstone projects that combine data visualization with AI/ML

applications.

● Stay up to date with the latest industry trends and tools in Data Science, AI/ML, and

Visual Analytics.

**3. Assessment and Feedback:**

● Develop and administer tests, quizzes, and projects to assess student progress.

● Provide constructive feedback and mentorship to help students excel.

**4. Student Engagement:**

● Foster an engaging and collaborative classroom environment.

● Assist students in troubleshooting database issues or practical exercises.

● Guide students on career opportunities in database management and related fields.

**5. Industry Relevance:**

● Share insights on industry practices and tools like MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB,

Oracle,Power BI, Excel, Tableau etc.

● Organize workshops, hackathons, or webinars for hands-on learning experiences.

**6. Collaboration:**

● Work with other instructors and departments to integrate database concepts into

multidisciplinary projects.

● Adapt teaching methodologies to suit diverse learning styles.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

1. Education/Experience:

●
**M.tech/Phd**
degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or

related fields.

● Expertise in Data Engineering.

● Certifications in database technologies (e.g., Oracle DBA, Microsoft SQL Server,

AWS Certified Database Specialist) are a plus.

2. Technical Skills:

● Proficiency in relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL

systems (MongoDB, Cassandra, Knn and Clustering).

● Tableau or Power BI.

● Strong command of Python, SQL, PL/SQL, or T-SQL.

● Familiarity with database design, normalization, indexing, and performance tuning.

● Knowledge of cloud database platforms like AWS RDS, Azure SQL, or Google

Cloud Spanner.

**Experience: 3+ years**
